What viabolat fixes

Concrete, real-world breakages — not vague "digital transformation."

Zapier & Make failures

Multi-step Zaps and Make scenarios that silently stopped firing, error out, or skip steps.

Broken webhooks & APIs

Webhooks that no longer deliver, expired tokens, and integrations that 401 or time out.

API & schema drift

A vendor changed a field or endpoint and your automation has been quietly mapping the wrong data.

Duplicate & missing records

Dedup logic that never worked, records dropped on the floor, or rows written twice.

Cron & Python scripts

Scheduled scripts that fail at 2am, crash on a bad input, or never got proper error handling.

Data extraction & cleanup

PDFs, spreadsheets, and exports that need reliable extraction, validation, and de-duplication.
